name: data-display/stat-counter
title: Animated stat counter
description: A figure that rolls to its new value.

files.content:
export { StatCounter } from './StatCounter';
export type { StatCounterProps } from './StatCounter';

notes: Only the final value is exposed to assistive technology, as plain text; the rolling digits are hidden from it.
It is not a live region, so changes are not announced by themselves; announce important changes separately.
The label is visible text beneath the number.
accessibility.reducedMotion: The value appears at once, with no roll.
